sections.title: Community, Identity and Urban Education
sections.description: This course explores how societal meanings, community dynamics, and individual identities are constructed, challenged, and transformed within educational settings, with a focus on urban education. It examines how dominant discourses shape and influence broader societal structures, particularly in urban schools, and how students engage with these processes within these contexts, navigating their own sense of identity and community. Students will critically investigate how these power dynamics function in urban educational environments, considering the implications for the purpose of education, community building, and the reinforcement or disruption of prevailing societal ideologies.
